claims.claim: All non-research clinical laboratory testing on humans in the US is regulated by CMS under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) program.
claims.episode_span: the analyzer itself must be purchased, validated, and maintained under CLIA or equivalent rules
claims.supporting_quote: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) regulates all laboratory testing (except research) performed on humans in the U.S. through the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) program

claims.claim: Lab tests are reimbursed per billing code under Medicare's Clinical Laboratory Fee Schedule, which sets a single national rate per test code with no geographic adjustment.
claims.episode_span: payers reimburse line items that match established CPT codes, so labs price to the code rather than to the marginal cost of the next test
claims.source_title: CPT 80053: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel Cost (2026 Medicare Rate vs Average Charge) | CareRoute
claims.supporting_quote: Lab tests are priced under the Clinical Laboratory Fee Schedule, not the Physician Fee Schedule. Medicare lab rates are set nationally and do not vary by geographic location

claims.claim: Providers bill far above the Medicare lab rate for the same panel: the average provider charge for a CMP is about $59.85 against a Medicare CLFS payment of $10.33 (a 5.8x markup), supporting the digest's point that hospital-bill figures are inflated list prices.
claims.episode_span: the one-hundred-to-several-hundred-dollar figures that appear on hospital bills are list prices that inflate the ratio another tenfold
claims.source_title: CPT 80053: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel Cost (2026 Medicare Rate vs Average Charge) | CareRoute
claims.supporting_quote: Medicare pays $10.33 for this test under the Clinical Laboratory Fee Schedule, but providers charge an average of $59.85 (a 5.8x markup)

claims.claim: Reagents for an entire 14-analyte comprehensive metabolic panel cost a lab only a few dollars (roughly $2-5), i.e. cents per individual assay -- a small fraction of what is billed.
claims.episode_span: A typical colorimetric or enzymatic assay for glucose, electrolytes, or liver enzymes uses microliter-scale volumes of commodity chemicals
claims.source_title: CPT 80053: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel Cost (2026 Medicare Rate vs Average Charge) | CareRoute
claims.supporting_quote: Running a CMP on an automated analyzer costs a lab roughly $2 to $5 in reagents
